name: Form
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of proper form and order in religious service, as seen when failure to follow God's prescribed order led to a breach among His people (1 Chronicles 15:13). The sanctification of priests and Levites was essential for carrying out sacred duties, such as bringing up the ark of the LORD (1 Chronicles 15:14). Even the timing of the Passover required careful adherence, with King Hezekiah and the congregation correcting previous irregularities by sanctifying themselves and gathering according to the established decree (2 Chronicles 30:2-5). These passages highlight that honoring God's commands in form and practice is vital for pleasing Him and maintaining covenant faithfulness.
